recalculation.notes: The primary-source EOS audit is complete, but the accessible evidence did not identify an exact pressure-calibration equation unambiguously enough to encode it.

pressure_calibration.notes: No reference EOS is inferred from experimental apparatus, pressure medium, author, or publication era.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Source-scope reproduction: Figure 2 displays the ice-VI PVT data as the 300 K and 340 K isotherms. The 15 intermediate-temperature rows in Table I form a pressure-temperature ramp and are not plotted there. The best-supported reconstruction selects the 23 rows at 298.7-300.7 K and the seven rows at 340.0-340.7 K; it recovers V0, K0, and alpha0 within combined two-sigma uncertainty.

fit.selection: 23 rows at 298.7-300.7 K and seven rows at 340.0-340.7 K

primary_source_check.finding: The source uses BM2 with T0=300 K, exponential constant-alpha reference-volume scaling, and dK/dT fixed to zero. Figure 2 displays the ice-VI P-V series at 300 and 340 K; fitting those 30 endpoint-isotherm rows reproduces Table II. Molar volume is converted with Z=10.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Table II with Equations (1)-(3) (p. 104505-4): BM2 with T0 = 300 K and exponential constant-alpha scaling of the reference volume.

primary_data_check.finding: All 45 H2O ice-VI P-V-T observations printed in Table I, from 1.26 to 2.81 GPa and 298.7 to 340.7 K.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table I, journal pages 104505-2 to 104505-3; Equations (1)-(3), journal page 104505-4; Figure 2 caption and Table II.

audit_corrections.reason: The thermal reference temperature in equations (2)-(3) was stored only at record level by the migration.

superseded_record_text.notes: PVT fit for pure H2O ice VI. The best-supported refit reconstruction uses the 300 K and 340 K isotherms displayed in Figure 2 (30 rows: 23 at 298.7-300.7 K and seven at 340.0-340.7 K). The 15 intermediate-temperature Table I observations are retained in the linked primary dataset but form a correlated pressure-temperature ramp and are not plotted in Figure 2. Published molar V0=14.17(2) cm^3/mol is converted to the Z=10 unit cell. The second-order Birch-Murnaghan form fixes K0'=4; dK/dT was fixed to zero because no temperature dependence was detectable. The numeric domains give the extrema of all ice-VI measurements tabulated in the paper.
